# Times

Times is a native macOS menu-bar world clock and date converter from Fortyone Agency LLC.

## Key pages

- [English product page](https://jsosa.net/times/): Product overview, features, privacy summary, and Mac App Store download.
- [Japanese product page](https://jsosa.net/times/ja/): Japanese product overview and download.
- [Privacy policy](https://jsosa.net/times/privacy/): How Times handles selected text, permissions, local preferences, and purchases.
- [Japanese privacy policy](https://jsosa.net/times/ja/privacy/): Japanese version of the privacy policy.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Fortyone-Agency/times): Times for macOS source repository.

Times does not collect personal data, analytics, or selected text. Date conversion happens locally on the user's Mac.
